verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with a public API, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The pack shows the API exists (an issues bulk-mutate endpoint and "API & third-party integrations" on the pricing page). However, nothing in it documents API version numbering, stability guarantees, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.
